analysis_protocols.fixed_point_bootstrap: Validation-fixed/default predictions; seed-average each image, then paired patient-cluster resampling; no threshold refitting
analysis_protocols.matched_fpr: Test-selected maximum lesion Dice subject to FPR <= target; descriptive and optimistically selected, no bootstrap inference
analysis_protocols.uncertainty: Across-seed sample SD is not a CI; bootstrap CI conditions on trained models and calibrated thresholds, excludes retraining/calibration uncertainty; unadjusted 95% intervals
